description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Arumugam Pillaiyanthamby as Vice Chairman and Mr. Thiyagarasa Puwasanthan as a member of the Navithanveli Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local government body (Navithanveli Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for both a Vice Chairman position and a member position, including nominations by political parties and declarations by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under election-related matters, making it Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) rather than government personnel changes (which would apply to national government positions, not local authority elections).
